summary: Form 8-K filed by AIM ImmunoTech reporting receipt of a NYSE American letter confirming the company has regained compliance with continued listing standards. The letter resolved stockholder equity deficiencies under NYSE American Company Guide Sections 1003(a)(i)-(iii). The compliance indicator ('.BC') will be removed from its trading symbol, and the company is off the noncompliant list. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change is announced. The filing is a routine compliance update.
